msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia isabel-mediavilla-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a pair of coral red and gold flamenco statement earrings with small flowers and leaves from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia isabel-mediavilla-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a pair of coral red and gold flamenco drop earrings with small flowers and leaves from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia isabel-mediavilla-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a pair of gold earrings with a square green stone and hanging baroque pearls from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia isabel-mediavilla-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a gold brooch shaped like a sprig of leaves with small crystals from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia isabel-mediavilla-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a long gold bar brooch with three oval stones in mint, coral and lilac from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
